verdict.rationale: Better Auth documents and hosts an official remote MCP server (mcp.better-auth.com) that exposes documentation search, examples, and setup help to MCP-capable clients like Cursor, Codex, and Claude Code, and a live probe confirms the endpoint responds correctly to an MCP initialize request. This is corroborated by first-party docs and an independent runtime check. Missing for 10: no independent/community write-up specifically confirming real-world agent usage of this MCP server (only vendor docs and the probe).
